decisions.scope: ROUND_TRIP sub-decision only (D1-D4); other OD-022 items unchanged
decisions.decision: APPROVED D1-D4. D1: SCH-FlightOffer 3.23 requires journey_type (ONE_WAY|ROUND_TRIP from provider slice count) and segment direction (OUTBOUND|INBOUND from slice order); segments stay one contiguous ordered array. D2: v3.4-shaped persisted offers are normalized on read to ONE_WAY/OUTBOUND without SQL migration. D3: a reprice whose segment/direction list differs from the stored snapshot is UNVERIFIED (RC-EVIDENCE-REPRICE-UNVERIFIED) and the existing selection is preserved. D4: requirement records RULE-FLT-002-07/08, FR-FLT-002-04, AC-FLT-002-07..09, TS-FLT-002-08..11, AC/TS-FLT-005-04, RULE-FLT-REPRICE-001-08, AC/TS-FLT-REPRICE-001-14..16; provider offers whose slice count/order/endpoints do not match the criteria are dropped. One EXACT/EXACT ROUND_TRIP search is one multi-slice provider request; independent one-way offers are never combined.
resolved: ROUND_TRIP - FlightOffer'da slice/yon yapisi yok (v3.11 remaining_open)

consequences_of_existing_contract.A1: single provider_offer_id per offer (SCH-FlightOffer, SCH-TripRequestFlightSelection, OP-repriceOffer, RULE-FLT-002-01)
consequences_of_existing_contract.A3: one total price for all directions and passengers (SCH-FlightOffer.price, RULE-FLT-REPRICE-001-07, RULE-FLT-005-02)
consequences_of_existing_contract.A4: offer-level baggage; UNKNOWN when directions differ (SCH-BaggageAllowance, RULE-FLT-005-01/02)
consequences_of_existing_contract.A5: selection stays on TripRequestFlightSelection; TripPlan unchanged (OD-021, OD-034 OPEN)
consequences_of_existing_contract.A7: no protection claim; bookable rule unchanged (OD-017, RULE-FLT-002-03)

remaining_open: PASSENGER type distribution (OD-020); adapter runs only with explicit ALL_ADULT deployment policy
decisions.approval_basis: Project owner instruction 2026-10-29: 'Project-owner approval applies to D1-D4 for ROUND_TRIP only' (docs/proposals/od-022-round-trip/approval-document.md)
